ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Potential PE Metadata Tamper Using Rcedit
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of rcedit to potentially alter executable PE metadata properties, which could conceal efforts to rename system utilities for defense evasion.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\rcedit\\-x64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rcedit\\-x86\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "Edit\ resources\ of\ exe" OR process_product = "rcedit") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-set\\-.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*OriginalFileName.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*CompanyName.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FileDescription.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ProductName.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ProductVersion.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*LegalCopyright.*")))
